tasks.title: Fix role, ID and ministry domain contracts
tasks.summary: Inventory IEADPE models and define the shared authorization, congregation and source-ID mapping before schema work.

Typed models preserve IEADPE contact/student/class/enrollment/session/attendance statuses, archive history and date-only values; legacy Firebase IDs are distinct from UUID primary keys.

tasks.title: Create ministry schema, grants and scoped queries
tasks.summary: Add PostgreSQL tables, RLS and bounded reads while preserving existing convert authorization.
acceptance: Every new table has RLS; anonymous, inactive, cross-congregation and forged direct writes are denied; authorized scoped reads use stable cursors and bounded pages.
Identity and congregation UUID mapping preserve unique source keys without name-based merging; no campaign grant silently becomes a ministry grant.
SQL tests exercise role matrix, revocation, empty/full page and unsupported filter combinations; existing convert access tests still pass.
Record expected Free-tier read/storage budget and Supabase shared-responsibility boundary.

tasks.title: Implement ministry registry commands
tasks.summary: Port congregation, team and student mutations into authorized RPCs.
acceptance: Create/update/archive and role replacement enforce scope, uniqueness, revision and operation-ID replay; concurrent role claims and revoked access are tested in independent sessions.
Student records preserve nullable baptism answers, required congregation and historical archive state; invalid and cross-scope payloads are denied.
Functions validate at the boundary, use documented lock order and return safe minimal results; no PII appears in errors or receipts.
A genuine failing assertion precedes each behavior fix and the full convert SQL suite remains green.

tasks.title: Implement academic and attendance commands
tasks.summary: Port class, enrollment, session, roster, attendance and progress invariants into authorized RPCs.
acceptance: RPCs enforce unique active enrollment, 100 total historical enrollments, frozen exact roster, finalized atomic attendance, revision and idempotent replay; 99/100/101 and both race orders are tested in independent sessions.
Progress is present/(present+absent) over finalized non-canceled sessions; excused/unmarked and zero denominator retain IEADPE semantics.
Invalid scope, stale revision, over-capacity, wrong roster and duplicate session cases roll back without partial writes.
Existing convert and registry SQL suites remain green.
